messages:
maya: Hey @ken @anya @jon — quick ping for PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/23109. It wires a new eviction fallback path and a small canary config change. Need runtime + infra + security eyes. Targeting canary Wed 2-4pm PST.
jon: thanks maya — can you summarize the risk surface in 1-2 bullets? which owners should I loop in for runtime?
maya: sure — TL;DR: control-plane only (routing + fallback); no model weights or data plane changes. Risks: 1) unexpected fallback loops causing increased latency, 2) missing metric so canary alerting might not fire. Runtime owners: ken, anya. Infra: @infra-team for autoscaler behavior. Security: @security-ops for config + KMS usage.
ken: 👀 I can take runtime review. can you paste the snippet that changes the fallback policy?
maya: pasted below — small yaml block:
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  max_attempts: 2
  backoff_ms: 150
  route_priority: [low_cost, low_latency]
```
Also added a metric emit: `runtime.fallback.count` and a tagging key `canary=true` when canary rollout is on.
anya: I can review perf and correctness tomorrow morning — can you add a quick perf comparison? even p50/p95 token latencies for a 512-seq workload.
maya: quick numbers from local benchmark: p50 ~ 32ms -> 35ms (+9%), p95 ~ 110ms -> 125ms (+13%). kv-cache hit rate unchanged. I'll attach the perf gist in PR.
ci-bot: CI — integration/runtime-tests failed on `eviction_tests::edge_case_timeout` (flaky). Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/12345. Rerun suggested.
jon: let's re-run CI once fixes are in. also, SRE: can we reserve Wed 2-4pm for a controlled canary? cc @infra-bot for autoscaler watch.
infra-bot: noted — reserving canary window Wed 14:00-16:00 PST. I'll have autoscaler logging on and an alert for rapid replica churn.
security-ops: quick Q — does this change any IAM/KMS scopes or introduce new secrets? need to know for signoff.
maya: no new secrets exposed. uses existing KMS key for control-plane encryption, same scopes as current deploy. I added an audit log flag to the rollout.
security-ops: thanks — will skim the PR. if no secrets and audit enabled, should be fine. will post final :thumbsup: by EOD.
ken: I'll do runtime code review now, should be able to approve by EOD if no major issues.
anya: I'll do perf + correctness tomorrow morning and ping back. if both runtime and infra OK, security OK, feel free to schedule the canary.
maya: great — thanks everyone. I'll update the PR with the perf gist and rerun CI, pinging again once tests are green. :pray:
